edits.new: A valid counterexample refutes that direction without further restriction tests. Before any full-coverage conclusion, explicitly test each applicable parent restriction absent from the child's explicit wording. Attempt a concrete case violating it where it constrains the kind, activity or role, while attempting to preserve every child requirement; adjudicate the case against all parent alternatives and permitted connections. For a particular-entity child, establish needed properties without assigning unknown facts. Reject admission only from contradictory child wording or a necessary implication. A restriction need not hold throughout the child if another parent alternative or permitted connection covers the cases lacking it. Customary cases and one covered example do not establish universal coverage.
edits.old: A valid counterexample refutes that direction without further restriction tests. Before any full-coverage conclusion, explicitly test each applicable parent identity or consumer restriction absent from the child's explicit wording: put an outside-class entity in the constrained role and adjudicate the concrete case against the whole child and all parent alternatives and permitted connections. Identify any necessary implication excluding it.

edits.new: including the prerequisite tests for positive coverage
edits.old: including the outside-class prerequisite for positive coverage
